answers.core: Yes, because the editor preview environment will be core in 4.0, and this would be a part of that.
answers.workaround: This will be used often and it makes sense to be core. This is supposed to be a preview environment for the editor, to make things easier. Working around this might require making your own preview environment system and circumventing the built-in one entirely (because none of the built-in preview environment stuff is exposed to scripting).
